text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I notice Bamboo Memory
standing
totally still while I'm walking
around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that! I was sleeping!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd go to bed early since I had a
break
and all, but I ended up waking up
earlier than I
expected...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I can't let a little sleepiness like this get the best of me... Must get energy... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Bamboo Memory didn't get
enough
rest.
